features.text: MECHANICAL ADVANTAGE PULLEY SYSTEM: Provides even, effortless compression for spinal stabilization.
ADJUSTABLE UNIVERSAL FIT: Supports waist sizes 25"-55" with breathable, lightweight mesh.
INTEGRATED LUMBAR SUPPORT: Wide back panel stabilizes the lower spine during recovery.
EASY-TO-USE DESIGN: Pull handles for instant tightening and adjust compression as needed.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
